subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should maintainers accept the shared core lifecycle as the final ownership boundary after exact-head checks complete, or require additional live multi-channel proof before merging this large refactor?
rationale: The branch deliberately centralizes behavior that affects message visibility, retry, session recording, and completion ordering across many transports; choosing the required confidence bar is a maintainer risk decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Refresh and merge after gates
options.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, require all exact-head checks to pass, then merge with owner review of the completed focused regression evidence.

options.title: Require live channel confirmation
options.body: Request redacted live proof for one or more representative channels before merging if maintainers want runtime confirmation beyond the behavior-neutral test override.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge after gates
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, require all exact-head checks to pass, then merge with owner review of the completed focused regression evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged foundation and this follow-up, so they are the best available owner for explaining the lifecycle invariants and merge boundary.
